title: Elicited Adaptation: Auditable Localized Fairness via Pairwise Queries
abstract: arXiv:2611.19686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How much must a predictor's scores change when a community's elicited fairness standard changes? Similarity and tolerance judgments define protected comparisons and acceptable score gaps. We study minimum uniform score movement on a fixed pool of $n$ profiles. For scores satisfying a source standard, we characterize the exact cost of retaining that standard during adaptation: runs of consecutive target constraints along shortest paths determine the optimal amplification factor. Its sharp worst case is $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$, and a full cost curve describes finite target-only repair budgets. Committing before the target is known can cost $n-1$ times the worst repair after revelation, even within one fixed convex ball of two-dimensional Mahalanobis metrics. translated_title: 引致适应：通过成对查询实现可审计的局部化公平性
translated_abstract: 当一个社区通过征询得到的公平性标准发生变化时，预测器的评分必须改变多少？相似性与容忍度判断定义了受保护的比较关系以及可接受的评分差距。我们研究了在一个固定的包含 $n$ 个档案的集合上的最小统一评分移动。对于满足源标准的评分，我们刻画了在适应过程中保持该标准的确切代价：沿最短路径的连续目标约束串决定了最优放大因子，其精确的最坏情形为 $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$，且一条完整的代价曲线描述了有限的目标端修复预算。在目标标准已知之前做出承诺，其代价可能达到目标揭示后最坏修复的 $n-1$ 倍，即使是在二维马氏度量的单个固定凸球内也是如此。正的边预算下限对这两个因子都构成上限；有界的几何结构也限制了承诺代价。在达到 $n-1$ 界的构造的两个内部目标处，相似性查询……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文刻画了当社区征询的公平性标准变化时预测器评分所需的最小统一调整代价——证明维持源标准的最坏情形代价为 $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$、而提前承诺的代价可达事后最坏修复的 $n-1$ 倍——并据此提出一种通过成对相似性与容忍度查询实现可审计局部化公平性的适应框架。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the exact minimum uniform score movement required when a community's elicited fairness standard changes—showing a sharp worst case of $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$ for retaining a source standard and that committing before the target is revealed can cost $n-1$ times the worst repair—thereby establishing an auditable localized fairness framework based on pairwise similarity and tolerance queries.
